# Answered design sketches — ready for independent review

2026-10-08. Author: Codex, separate sketch-author advisor under Joe's proxy orchestrator. No independent self-signoff. A fresh different advisor must review the exact proposals below. “Ready” means ready to review, not ready for implementation, dispatch or merge.

Main inspected: b46aec1e674baae5a329416d4119e67b59200a88. `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` advertised the same SHA during inspection; local main remained there after publication. Read AGENTS.md, two-seat protocol, rework-brief craft, seat recovery playbooks, canonical EPIC-74 and STORY-1481/1482/1483/1486, shipped STORY-1473, and the September target/parent plan. No build or test suite run; named tests in proposals are future verification obligations.

## Exact operator evidence

Canonical `aida show --format json --no-git` snapshots, not interpretation of old prose:

- EPIC-74: decision_request.answered=0 (UI choice 1), answered_at 2026-10-08T15:54:26.321418310Z, “Target and parent branch model”, consequence requiring amended sketch/ADR and store-side exclusion.
- STORY-1486: answered=0 (UI choice 1), answered_at 2026-10-08T15:54:29.273727039Z, “Profile without exemptions”, consequence “Scope writable roots and Git policy; preserve approval prompts”.

Both answers have resolution=noop. Neither answer itself changes status or supplies sketch signoff. Original and post-comment snapshots are under `answered-sketch-evidence/` beside this report; `publication.json` records exact comment/body correspondence.

## Review artifacts and canonical comments

All paths below are relative to `/home/joe/ai/aida/.aida/handoff/orchestrator/run-20261008/`.

| Artifact | Canonical publication | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EPIC74_AMENDED_SKETCH.md | EPIC-74 comment 01a11c5a-e2df-7160-ac9d-012fd9331b18 | 1105ae45cfa11db5a9c407e097ae5b95473bc4db8dbfa8ed1d515ac510e4f9a9 |
| EPIC74_CHILD_ACCEPTANCE_PROPOSED_AMENDMENT.md | Proposed artifact only; child descriptions were not edited | a50d69f0fcefa57f4e9953e8dcd9f31ae80fed90f6913f367e153a1a6b04d4c2 |
| STORY1486_AMENDED_SKETCH.md | STORY-1486 comment 01a11c5b-255b-7b91-881d-243f9e2b5db5 | 6bed750343f488083dc2fced9eb794e65f2c89dc8f32a5d205812358a7a81f75 |

Both full canonical comments begin `SKETCH (awaiting advisor signoff):` and are authored `codex-sketch-author`. Re-read through canonical show and compared exact full bodies to files after posting. CLI persisted own comments as store commits 7ea64898230dc0af1346dec3f4f4e96faf47c34c (EPIC-74) and 15c254f8a11715f665ac3916e7ba803a8321e46e (STORY-1486). No code commit, PR, merge or push performed. No explicit store sync/push performed; canonical comments are locally persisted. Cache contention was reported on the second write; subsequent canonical read verified its full content, so no cache rebuild was needed.

## What the different advisor must resolve

EPIC-74 preserves canonical exclusion even without session env, names every selector/action surface, binds checks to store/PR revisions, retains current ship/reopen/attribution gates, and distinguishes Done on non-default from verified default landing. No lane seat/system is added. The child artifact reconciles each acceptance item rather than dispatching obsolete lane acceptance. Outstanding bounded forks: old generic --force override versus explicit isolation release, clearing isolation with live/unlanded work, and optional versus same-as-default parent representation. Review must also validate coverage evidence across squash landing and the proposed typed schema; an ADR is still required before implementation. No answer from an absent operator was inferred.

STORY-1486 preserves prompts and proposes replacing the exemption-list acceptance, uses shipped seat and binary-resolution semantics, and separates requested roots/Git mode from actual enforceability. Strong “cannot run a Git write” is not provided by writable-root configuration, read-only .git, PATH wrappers or current bypass launch paths. Current session sandbox is disabled; its root list is not a boundary. The proposal refuses unsupported restricted launches and expressly does not call refusal alone full functional success. Residual operator-only fork: retain strong guarantee pending an independently reviewed backend, or explicitly narrow the contract to AIDA-mediated operations with accepted limitations. No narrowing has been selected. This is a material implementation-readiness blocker, not permission to add a broker or bypass prompts.

The review should return an independent verdict with exact hashes and required amendments. The sketch author is recused from approving these proposals. Preserve the existing recorded direction; do not re-open the settled target/parent versus lane choice or restore exemption proposals by accident.

## Scope and integrity evidence

Only these handoff artifacts/evidence and the two own canonical comments were written. EPIC-74 and STORY-1486 remained Draft on re-read. No source edits, child-spec edits, queue/status changes, grants, hold changes, launches or dispatches. Existing unrelated untracked files were preserved. The source files recorded in `answered-sketch-evidence/source-hashes.json` had unchanged SHA-256 values after publication, and main HEAD was unchanged.

TASK-1593, TASK-1591, BUG-1811 and BUG-1812 remain external-agent reservations. No source/spec changes or assignments made to them. Shipped authority/CLI behavior is reused; upcoming external changes and TASK-1613's ship-wrapper seam require a fresh main check before future implementation. No autonomous wake, TTY bypass, exemption list, production activation or unseen product decision is authorized.

Advisor mailbox notification uses this report as its body; notification ID and report hash are captured in `answered-sketch-evidence/mailbox-notification.json` after send.
